title: DeHub’s next chapter: Riftn, BNB recovery and the road to relaunch
html:
DeHub is approaching what could be the most important turning point in its history: a proposed new name, a renewed push to recover the BNB stuck in our old contract, and a clear plan for relaunching and getting listed.

We believe we have a strong case for recovery through Binance’s Pioneer Burn Programme. Alongside that effort, we have finally secured the short, catchy and meaningful .com domain we have spent years looking for: riftn.com.

These are the next steps, why we believe they offer the strongest route forward, and what they mean for our community.

Recovering our community’s BNB

Binance’s BNB Pioneer Burn Programme provides a route for eligible lost BNB to be reimbursed, with the amounts accounted for in its token burns.

We believe the BNB stuck in our old contract deserves a proper assessment under that programme. Recovery is not guaranteed: Binance must review our case and approve it.

The frustration is that we have struggled to get that assessment. The only application route we were directed to was Binance’s support chat, where we were asked what an LP was.

Many community members will remember BNB tweeting us last year following our efforts to start the recovery process. However, the team we were working with were all let go by BNB Chain before we could get an answer from Binance.

Our contact Walter, who was head of business development at BNB Chain and was trying to help us recover the BNB, advised us to get loud on Twitter and attract the Binance team’s attention.

That is the route we intend to pursue.

Nearly $1 million of our community’s money is stuck. For our relaunch, there is no bigger potential catalyst than recovering those funds. A programme exists to assess cases involving lost BNB, and we want ours to receive a clear answer.

A proposed new name: Riftn

Finding a better name has been a priority for three years.

DeHub was a great name initially, but we have outgrown it. The name and domain place us firmly within crypto and technology, while the platform needs to appeal to the general public.

We have now secured riftn.com. Subject to a majority community vote, the proposed move to Riftn will take place next week.

The icon will remain. It is already well loved and perfectly symbolises the new name.

Rifting is the geological process in which the Earth’s crust pulls apart, reshaping the landscape and creating the conditions for new seas and land.

That meaning captures what we are trying to do: create something new through disruption. Riftn.com — R-I-F-T-N, dot com — is short, memorable and meaningful. It is the domain we have been waiting for.

The relaunch will also introduce a new token that brings everyone together under one contract, while maintaining the application’s existing compatibility with Base, Robinhood, Solana, Arc, Ethereum and BNB.

Why we are returning our focus to BNB

The next step is to focus on BNB while publicly pursuing our Pioneer Burn application.

Transaction costs have fallen to levels comparable with Base, making the application easier to sustain on BNB. Discussions around the next BNB upgrade add to the case for returning our focus to the chain.

This also gives us the strongest opportunity to attract the attention and support of the Binance team, the wider crypto community and the general public.

Our move towards Base a few years ago made sense at the time. Transactions were around ten times cheaper, while our experience developing on BNB involved long periods without the GitHub updates we needed, persistent bugs and other issues we have previously highlighted.

That situation has changed. So has our view of Base.

Our concerns about Base’s treatment of builders are serious: the appropriation of open-source projects, funding for competing “vampire” clones, and support for projects we regard as Ponzi schemes associated with notorious bad actors.

We cannot, in good faith, continue prioritising Base as our main chain. Compatibility will remain.

Looking at DeHub’s position as a whole, we believe this route offers the strongest chance of a successful relaunch that captures attention across Crypto Twitter and beyond.

What happens to existing balances?

Your existing balances will remain.

The application already reads your staked balances and holdings across both chains. After listing, you will need to log in once to claim your balance.

The new token will bring everyone onto the same chain and contract, providing the cleanest possible fresh start.

Everything will happen on dehub.io/riftn.com. You do not need to visit any other website, speak to an administrator or share your keys with anyone.

Further details about the new token and the switchover will follow.

The recovery campaign and alternative plan

We believe this approach gives us the best chance of a strong relaunch, and we expect the wider crypto community to understand why these funds deserve a proper recovery assessment.

We believe our case meets the Pioneer Burn criteria. However, community support and a public campaign cannot guarantee Binance’s approval.

If the request is rejected, we will reassess the situation and pursue an alternative listing strategy. Solana is one option: we have already had positive conversations with members of its ecosystem and remain open to exploring that route.

Our conviction remains that Binance should assess our case fairly under its own programme. We intend to make that case publicly and persistently.

The campaign will begin on 5 November and continue as we seek an answer. If we are making no meaningful progress by mid-to-late November, we will move ahead with the alternative listing strategy already being prepared.

The target: trading before December

Our target is to be trading before December, ahead of the holiday season, when more people are at home, browsing the web and spending money.

The proposed name change, recovery campaign and listing plan are all part of the same effort: giving DeHub the strongest possible fresh start.

Community feedback remains central to that process, particularly the vote on the Riftn name. Share your thoughts in posts on the app.
